words.rule: Night parking needs a City permit. With one, park on the side with even house numbers on nights with an even date (the date before midnight) and on the odd side on odd dates, 2 to 6 AM. Most streets alternate all year; from December 1 to March 1 through highways and bus routes have no night parking on either side.
words.afterpass: Wrong side: a $30 ticket ($25 with no night permit, $35 on a through highway or bus route in winter). Sunday mornings and the mornings of and after seven holidays are free. In a declared snow emergency the hours are 10 PM to 6 AM, tickets are $50 to $150, and cars can be towed.
words.dataNotes: Nights are listed from October 2026 to October 2027. Odd and even sides come from the address ranges on the City's street centerlines. Streets on the City's Exception Streets map that allow both sides every night are left off; its blue streets alternate only December 1 to March 1, and its through highways and bus routes show no night parking on either side then, and the standard rule the rest of the year. Posted signs, including streets signed for one side, are not in this data and always come first.
